answer: The registry splits each newcomer's signing key by Shamir 3-of-3 and deals one share to a VRF-drawn custodian in each age tier, called sparrow below 20 epochs, meadow from 20 to 99, and karst at 100 or more. Every custodian escrows 12 tokens, forfeited when two shares sign together outside a liveness ping. Faking 10,000 identities demands 30,000 custody seats, 360,000 escrowed tokens (about 54,000 USD at 0.15) and 100 epochs of aging for the karst seats. Each clone ends up as a vault door with three locks cut at separate mills, and the thief must own every mill.
